# AllisWell

> Source-available, self-hostable tasks, projects, notes, files and alarm-grade reminders,
> with two-way Google & Apple Calendar sync. One Flutter app for iOS, Android, Web, macOS,
> Windows and Linux. Free for personal use. Made by BubiApps (info@bubiapps.com).

## MCP connector (Claude, ChatGPT, any MCP client)

- Connector URL for alliswell.space accounts: https://api.alliswell.space/mcp
- Self-hosted instances: <API_PUBLIC_URL>/mcp, e.g. https://api.your-domain.example/mcp
- The URL is on the API host. https://alliswell.space/mcp is the website, not the MCP server.
- Transport: Streamable HTTP. Auth: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256); dynamic client registration
  (RFC 7591) and OAuth client ID metadata documents are both supported.
- OAuth discovery: https://api.alliswell.space/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and
  https://api.alliswell.space/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the URL → Connect → sign in
  with the AllisWell email and password.
- Claude Team / Enterprise: an Owner adds it under Organization settings → Connectors; each
  member then presses Connect under Settings → Connectors. No client ID or secret needed.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http alliswell https://api.alliswell.space/mcp`
- Tools: tasks, checklists, reminders, notes, projects, tags, search, file metadata. Write
  tools ask for approval; there is no delete tool.
